Emperor penguins live in Antarctica, the coldest place on Earth. To stay warm in freezing winds, hundreds of them huddle together in a tight group. The birds on the outside slowly move to the middle, and the warm ones in the middle take a turn on the cold edge.

What can you infer about why the penguins take turns moving to the middle?
A) So every bird gets a chance to warm up
B) So they can race each other
C) So they can find food faster
D) So they can build nests
items.answer: A) So every bird gets a chance to warm up

steps: This asks for an inference, so I combine clues.
The birds huddle "to stay warm," and the cold ones on the edge move to the warm middle.
Taking turns lets each bird warm up, so the answer is A.
solution.answer: A) So every bird gets a chance to warm up
